entities.summary: Sir Charles Lanyon DL, JP was an English architect of the 19th century. His work is most closely associated with Belfast, Northern Ireland. Charles Lanyon was a architects & engineers from Eastbourne (1813-01-06, Eastbourne–1889-05-31). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
